name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:

jobs:
  # Build, test, typecheck, lint and package the worker
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Build worker
        run: npm run build --workspace lexical-search-worker

  # Deploy the worker to Cloudflare
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Publish worker
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v1
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: publish
          wranglerVersion: '3'

  # Sync D1 database after deployment
  sync:
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run sync script (if defined)
        run: npm run sync --workspace lexical-search-worker
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Execute D1 sync
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v1
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: d1 execute --file=sync.sql
          wranglerVersion: '3'
